correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs exact child-event counts by the constant coefficient of (z^-1+2+z)^n and independence across disjoint atoms/subtrees. The root count is Bin(n,c_n^k); Stirling gives rates n^(1-k/2) leading to divergence, Poisson(1/pi), or disappearance. The recursive semantics substitutes the depth-one limit zero, so root success has probability zero. The standalone checker directly enumerates relevant valuations and independently reconstructs finite threshold laws; the infinite limit uses the proof, not finite computation.
